\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{4-x-y}2x\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{4-x-y}2x\,dz]dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}2x[z]_{z=0}^{z=4-x-y}\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}2x(4-x-y)\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}(8x-2{x}^{2}-2xy)\,dy\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{1}(8x-2{x}^{2}-2xy)\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{1}(8x-2{x}^{2}-2xy)\,dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[8xy-2{x}^{2}y-x{y}^{2}]_{y=0}^{y=1}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(8x-2{x}^{2}-x)\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(7x-2{x}^{2})\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}7x-2{x}^{2}\,dx & ={[\frac{7{x}^{2}}{2}-\frac{2{x}^{3}}{3}]}_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{7}{2}-\frac{2}{3} \\  & =\frac{17}{6}\end{aligned}
$$
